groups.title: Patterns
groups.note: Type in the filter box above the file list (shown with 2 or more files). It matches file names, in any case.

rows.action: Plain text: names that contain it (my-notes.md, Notes.txt)
^ is the start of the name: names that begin with read
$ is the end, \. is a real dot: names that end in .md
. is any one character: abc, a-c, a1c
.* is anything, even nothing: draft-v2.md, draft notes v2.txt
| is either side, ( ) groups it: names that end in .md or .txt
Starts with a, third character b, ends in .text: axb-notes.text
Not a valid pattern: searched as plain text, with a note under the box
With a file row focused: go to the filter box
In the filter box: go to the first match
In the filter box: clear it; folders open or close as they were
